name: Akita International University
summary: Public university in Akita, founded 2004, teaching wholly in English: one liberal-arts degree with Global Business, Studies or Connectivity.

ib.text: Applicants with the IB must have completed the curriculum and passed the six final exams, shown by certificates before enrolment. TOEFL iBT 61, IELTS 6.0 or similar, or three years of English-medium schooling.

apply.via: AIU online application site, binding commitment

dates.label: Online application and fee payment opens, 10:00 JST
Online application and fee payment closes, 23:00 JST
Application documents must arrive at AIU

programmes.name: International Liberal Arts
programmes.about: A four-year liberal-arts degree taught entirely in English, in which you later choose between the Global Business, Global Studies and Global Connectivity programmes.
programmes.selectionNote: Transcripts and a 500-word statement of purpose, then an online interview. Only 5 seats in this September 2027 International Examination, and an offer is a binding commitment.

notes: This exam is a binding commitment: if you are accepted you agree to cancel all other applications and enrol at AIU.
First-year fees also include a one-off matriculation fee of ¥423,000 (¥282,000 for Akita residents) and a residence-hall fee; students are expected to live in the dormitory for the first year.
AIU's April entry is a separate exam in a different cycle; the dates here are for the September 2027 International Examination.
